Usage

/* Override tokens in your CSS */
:root {
  --color-brand-500: #8b5cf6;  /* Change primary color */
  --radius-lg: 20px;           /* Change border radius */
}

/* Or use Tailwind classes */
<div className="bg-brand-500 rounded-lg p-4">
  Themed content
</div>
